# Shibboleth

## Single sign-on (SAML 2.0)

In the portal, choose **Shibboleth** under Enterprise SSO and **Start with Shibboleth**. Then, in Shibboleth:

1. In conf/metadata-providers.xml, add a FileBackedHTTPMetadataProvider whose metadataURL is our metadata URL below, with a backingFile.
2. In conf/attribute-filter.xml, add an AttributeFilterPolicy whose Requester rule names our entity ID and that releases mail (and the name attributes).
3. In conf/saml-nameid.xml, add a SAML2AttributeSourcedGenerator for the emailAddress format sourced from mail.
4. In conf/relying-party.xml, add a RelyingPartyByName override for our entity ID setting nameIDFormatPrecedence to the emailAddress format.
5. Send us your IdP metadata (metadata/idp-metadata.xml as you publish it).

### The values the portal shows

| Shibboleth field | Value |
|---|---|
| metadataURL (conf/metadata-providers.xml → &lt;MetadataProvider xsi:type="FileBackedHTTPMetadataProvider"&gt;) | The portal's SP metadata URL (`https://…/sso/saml/…/metadata`) |
| value (conf/attribute-filter.xml → &lt;PolicyRequirementRule xsi:type="Requester"&gt;) | The portal's entity ID (`https://…/sso/saml/…`) |
| nameIDFormatPrecedence (conf/relying-party.xml → SAML2.SSO) | `urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:1.1:nameid-format:emailAddress` |

### What to bring back

Get **idp-metadata.xml** and paste the XML into the portal's **Metadata URL or XML**.

The assertion must be signed, and must carry the person's email address as an attribute or as a NameID in the `emailAddress` format. See [Any SAML 2.0 provider](generic-saml.md) for the details.

Shibboleth's own guide: <https://shibboleth.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/IDP5/pages/3199506865/FileBackedHTTPMetadataProvider>.

Then verify your domain and turn single sign-on on in the portal: [Enterprise SSO](../sso.md).
